summary: Parked-up Moggill Road shop kerb; busy and in full view, daytime limits only.
reasons: Cars already park along this kerb
Shopfronts, not homes, face the kerb

drivers.seclusion: Shops 4-8 m behind the footpath, Axis Taringa apartments 19 m away; passers-by and shop staff would notice.
drivers.access_and_room: Parked cars line the kerb, so a van can pull in beside them.
drivers.traffic: Busy shopping-strip arterial with buses; noisy.
drivers.convention: Signed 2P and 1/4P only in daytime hours; cars park here, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Section slope low, but 3.4% mean over whole stretch
sun_shade: Open to the south sun; shop awnings and street trees shade patches.

best_section.where: north kerb of Moggill Road outside the shopfronts west of the costume shop
